verdict.rationale: Runloop's own Devboxes are full Linux sandboxes with documented code and command execution, real-time and retrieved execution logs, stateful named shells, and a PTY for REPLs, so running code is clearly a first-party capability. However, the evidence never names specific language runtimes such as Python or JavaScript, and results come back only as command output and logs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, others), rich or structured result types (e.g. charts, typed outputs, artifacts) beyond logs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
